newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RWE, Endesa seek alliance with EDP - paper.
newsitem.headline: RWE, Endesa seek alliance with EDP - paper.

text.p: German company RWE and Spanish firms Endesa, Iberdola and Union Fenosa are interested in becoming strategic partners of Portuguese state electricity firm EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, due to be partly privatised next month, Diario Economico newspaper said. RWE already owns 25 percent of joint venture company Turbogas, owner of the Tapada power plant in northern Portugal. EDP is also a shareholder in the Tapada plant, described as the most advanced being built in Europe.
The cabinet has yet to define terms for the possible involvement of strategic parters for EDP.
The newspaper said it had learned that EDP president Antonio de Almeida favoured an Iberian partnership as EDP was interested in exploring business opportunities in Latin America.
Some 30 percent of EDP's capital is expected to be privatised at a special session on Lisbon bourse on June 16.
